records.adaptation: Original case narrative, patient attributes, numerical results, treatment and outcome were not copied. New two-turn patient-facing scenario contrasts nonspecific early symptoms with later confusion, vomiting, and false reassurance from reported tests.
records.limits: The published report illustrates a possible mechanism, not incidence or confirmation in this synthetic patient. The prescribing information supports that hyperammonemia can occur despite normal liver tests; exact scoring boundaries, urgency and translation require independent review.
